plugins.name: Auto Dialer
plugins.author: AiPBX Official Team
plugins.description: Automated outbound calling campaigns with Asterisk Answering Machine Detection (AMD), queue free-agent pacing, voicemail drop, numbers from a list or an external database, campaign managers, and results by webhook or written back to your database.

description_i18n.tr: Asterisk Telesekreter Tespiti (AMD), kuyruk boşta operatör hız kontrolü, telesekretere sesli mesaj, numaraları listeden ya da dış veritabanından alma, kampanya yöneticileri ve sonuçları webhook ile gönderme ya da veritabanınıza geri yazma ile otomatik dış arama kampanyaları.
description_i18n.en: Automated outbound calling campaigns with Asterisk Answering Machine Detection (AMD), queue free-agent pacing, voicemail drop, numbers from a list or an external database, campaign managers, and results by webhook or written back to your database.

plugins.name: Caller Name (CNAM)
plugins.author: AiPBX community
plugins.description: Caller ID name lookup for inbound calls: checks active extensions & SMS contacts, then queries BulkVS, Telnyx, Twilio, Vonage, OpenCNAM, SignalWire, NumVerify, AbstractAPI or custom URL with local caching to reduce costs.

description_i18n.en: Caller ID name lookup for inbound calls: checks active extensions & SMS contacts, then queries BulkVS, Telnyx, Twilio, Vonage, OpenCNAM, SignalWire, NumVerify, AbstractAPI or custom URL with local caching to reduce costs.
description_i18n.tr: Gelen aramalarda arayan adı sorgulaması: önce dahili rehberi kontrol eder, ardından BulkVS, Telnyx, Twilio, Vonage, OpenCNAM, SignalWire, NumVerify, AbstractAPI veya özel URL ile sorgulayıp maliyeti düşürmek için önbelleğe alır.

plugins.name: LDAP / Active Directory contacts
plugins.author: AiPBX
plugins.description: Reads the people of your company directory (Active Directory, OpenLDAP) into the AiPBX phonebook, so desk phones find them by name and show who is calling.

description_i18n.en: Reads the people of your company directory (Active Directory, OpenLDAP) into the AiPBX phonebook, so desk phones find them by name and show who is calling.
description_i18n.tr: Şirket dizininizdeki (Active Directory, OpenLDAP) kişileri AiPBX rehberine alır; masa telefonları onları adıyla bulur ve arayanın adını gösterir.

plugins.name: SIP Provider Templates
plugins.author: AiPBX community
plugins.description: Create a SIP trunk from a provider template written by the community. Needs AiPBX 1.60.6 or newer.

description_i18n.en: Create a SIP trunk from a provider template written by the community. Needs AiPBX 1.60.6 or newer.
description_i18n.tr: Topluluğun yazdığı sağlayıcı şablonundan SIP trunk oluşturur. AiPBX 1.60.6 veya üstü gerekir.

plugins.name: SMS / MMS
plugins.author: AiPBX community
plugins.description: Text messages on your numbers through Twilio, Vonage, Plivo, Telnyx, Bandwidth, Sinch, VoIP.ms or BulkVS. The users a number is given to read and answer them. Needs AiPBX 1.71 or newer.

description_i18n.en: Text messages on your numbers through Twilio, Vonage, Plivo, Telnyx, Bandwidth, Sinch, VoIP.ms or BulkVS. The users a number is given to read and answer them. Needs AiPBX 1.71 or newer.
description_i18n.tr: Numaralarınıza gelen ve giden kısa mesajlar: Twilio, Vonage, Plivo, Telnyx, Bandwidth, Sinch, VoIP.ms veya BulkVS. Numaranın verildiği kullanıcılar okur ve yanıtlar. AiPBX 1.71 veya üstü gerekir.

plugins.name: VoIP Billing
plugins.author: AiPBX community
plugins.description: Multi-account VoIP call billing and draft invoice creation (ClientFence) from outbound CDRs using extension mappings and prefix rates.

description_i18n.en: Multi-account VoIP call billing and draft invoice creation (ClientFence) from outbound CDRs using extension mappings and prefix rates.
description_i18n.tr: Dahili eşleştirmeleri ve ön ek tarifeleri kullanarak giden çağrı kayıtlarından (CDR) çoklu hesap VoIP ücretlendirme ve taslak fatura (ClientFence) oluşturma.
